description: This file implements JWT-based authentication and authorization for a proxy server, including token validation, role mapping, scope enforcement, and user/team object management.

classes.name: JWTHandler
classes.description: Handles JWT token validation, role mapping, scope enforcement, and fetching user info from OIDC endpoints.

methods.name: update_environment
methods.description: Sets the environment variables for JWT validation, including Prisma client, cache, and auth config.

methods.name: is_jwt
methods.description: Checks if a token string is a valid JWT format.

methods.name: get_rbac_role
methods.description: Determines the RBAC role of a token (admin, team, user, or none).

methods.name: is_admin
methods.description: Checks if the token scopes include admin scope.

methods.name: get_team_ids_from_jwt
methods.description: Extracts team IDs from JWT token based on configured field.

methods.name: get_end_user_id
methods.description: Retrieves end user ID from token based on configured field.

methods.name: is_required_team_id
methods.description: Indicates if a team ID is required based on config.

methods.name: is_enforced_email_domain
methods.description: Checks if email domain enforcement is enabled.

methods.name: get_team_id
methods.description: Extracts team ID from token based on configured field, with fallback to default.

methods.name: is_upsert_user_id
methods.description: Determines if user ID should be upserted based on config and email validation.

methods.name: get_user_id
methods.description: Retrieves user ID from token based on configured field.

methods.name: get_user_roles
methods.description: Extracts user roles from token based on configured field.

methods.name: map_jwt_role_to_litellm_role
methods.description: Maps JWT roles to internal LiteLLM user roles.

methods.name: get_jwt_role
methods.description: Retrieves JWT roles from token based on configured field.

methods.name: is_allowed_user_role
methods.description: Checks if user roles are within allowed roles.

methods.name: get_user_email
methods.description: Extracts user email from token based on configured field.

methods.name: get_object_id
methods.description: Retrieves object ID from token based on configured field.

methods.name: get_org_id
methods.description: Retrieves organization ID from token based on configured field.

methods.name: get_scopes
methods.description: Extracts scopes from token, handling string or list formats.

methods.name: get_public_key
methods.description: Fetches public key(s) for JWT validation, with caching.

methods.name: parse_keys
methods.description: Parses key(s) from JSON response, matching by kid if provided.

methods.name: is_allowed_domain
methods.description: Checks if user email domain matches allowed domain.

methods.name: get_oidc_userinfo
methods.description: Fetches user info from OIDC UserInfo endpoint, with caching.

methods.name: auth_jwt
methods.description: Validates and decodes JWT token using public keys.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes HTTP handler connection.
